title: Terminal grid state (v1)
description: Snapshot of a terminal emulator's visible screen after feeding a corpus case. Serializers SHOULD omit cell fields equal to their documented defaults and MAY trim trailing all-default cells from each row; consumers MUST re-normalize. A null value in any nullable field means 'producer cannot observe this' and is treated as a wildcard by the differ.

case.description: Corpus case name this snapshot was produced from.

cursor.description: 0-based screen coordinates. col MUST be clamped to [0, cols-1]; a pending-wrap cursor reports the last column.

altScreen.description: True if the alternate screen buffer (DECSET 47/1047/1049) is active at snapshot time.

title.description: Terminal window title as last set by OSC 0/2. Empty string if never set; null if unobservable.

rows.description: Exactly size.rows entries (top to bottom). Each row holds at most size.cols cells (left to right); trailing all-default cells may be trimmed.

color.description: "default" = terminal default fg/bg; integer = 256-color palette index; "#rrggbb" = truecolor; null = unobservable.

text.description: Cell contents: base character plus any combining marks (uncombined; differ compares NFC-normalized). Unwritten/erased cells MUST serialize as a single space. Wide-char continuation cells MUST serialize as "" with width 0.

width.description: 2 = lead cell of a wide (e.g. CJK) character; 0 = continuation cell of a wide character; 1 otherwise.
